name: montgomery_recent
description: Recent records from a common Montgomery County, MD open dataset (data.montgomerycountymd.gov) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime in Montgomery County, MD", "Montgomery County, MD 311 requests", "Montgomery County, MD building permits". Names: 311, crime, permits. Returns the latest rows (newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use montgomery_query.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter. Omit for all recent rows.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: montgomery_query
description: Run a raw SoQL query against any Montgomery County, MD open-data resource (data.montgomerycountymd.gov) by its Socrata id (8-char like "icn6-v9z3"). Full SoQL: where/select/group/order/limit/offset. Use montgomery_datasets to find a resource id, or montgomery_recent for the common ones.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: montgomery_datasets
description: Search the Montgomery County, MD open-data catalogue (data.montgomerycountymd.gov) for datasets by keyword. Returns dataset names, descriptions, and Socrata resource ids to use with montgomery_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.
